title: Can I BEAT 4 Player Team Chess?
summary: iwantcheckmate teams up with YouTuber Croissant for chess.com Team 4-Player Chess (teams of opposite seats, e.g. red+yellow vs blue+green). They coordinate opening traps, gang up on the weaker opponent (1500 blue vs 1800 green), and win 3/3 games by checkmating one of the enemy team's players.
rules: Four players on the cross-shaped 14x14 4-player board (8x8 core plus three 3-rank arms), each with a full army, moving clockwise (red, blue, yellow, green).
Players sitting opposite each other are teammates (red+yellow vs blue+green); teammates cannot capture each other.
Checkmating either player of the enemy team wins the game for your team.
If you are in check you must address it on your turn (stated at 33:01).
A king can castle; pieces of a teammate can be used as cover (castling next to a teammate shown at 44:02).
win_condition: Checkmate either opponent on the enemy team (team win).

opponent.name: Two online opponents (blue ~1500, green ~1800) with Croissant as teammate
opponent.avatar_description: chess.com default avatars; teammate Croissant (croissant logo)

board.shape_notes: Cross-shaped 4-player board: 14x14 with 3x3 corners removed (160 squares).

setup: Standard chess.com 4PC FFA layout: each colour's back rank + pawns on one arm (red bottom, blue left, yellow top, green right).
current_impl_issues: Current 'fourp' mode just lets each side move twice per turn on an 8x8 board; the video uses a real 4-player cross board with 4 armies and alternating clockwise turns, 2v2 teams.
Bot teammate needed: player controls one colour; ally and two enemies are bots.

current_impl.explain: You and the bot each move twice per turn, like two teams. Checkmate or capture the enemy king.

evidence: 0:01 'you and your teammate play to get checkmate against one of the other team's players; goal is to win three games'; 2:07 ratings 1500 blue/1800 green; 33:01 must address check; 45:04 won 3/3. Thumbnail: red+yellow kings VS blue+green kings.
